lines.en: Touka's been steadily getting better at archery, which is great because it means she's one step closer to being able to put me out of my misery in {i}one{/i} shot instead of four.
lines.zh: Touka 的弓道一直在稳步进步。这是好事，因为这意味着她离「{i}一箭{/i}就让我解脱、而不用四箭」又近了一步。

lines.en: I didn't come here to complain, though. That's what literally every other location is for. And if I'm going to go out of my way to visit the school on a day off, I should try to be positive.
lines.zh: 不过我不是来发牢骚的。发牢骚是其他所有地方的用途。既然我都特意在休息日跑来学校了，就该积极点。

lines.en: My mind navigates away from the cruel and hurtful things and hones in on the way Touka makes me feel instead. But in an unexpected turn of events, that winds up being even crueler.
lines.zh: 我的思绪避开那些残酷伤人的事，转而聚焦 Touka 给我的感觉。可没想到，这反而更残酷。

lines.en: As comedically {i}good{/i} and...intimately matriarchal as she is, there's something about her presence that confuses me. And now, I'm always confused whenever she's around.
lines.zh: 尽管她{i}有趣{/i}、又……带着点亲密的「母亲感」，可她的存在里有什么东西让我困惑。而现在，只要她在场，我就一直困惑。

lines.en: I wonder how she interprets this, as I know she's smart enough to realize the changes in my behavior. But I can never bring myself to ask.
lines.zh: 不知道她怎么解读这个——我知道她足够聪明，察觉得到我行为上的变化。可我始终开不了口问。

lines.en: She smiles at me. And for a moment, there's a bout of silence laced with what I {i}want{/i} to be understanding so I never need to open my mouth again.
lines.zh: 她对我笑了笑。那一刻，一阵沉默里掺着我所{i}期望{/i}的「理解」——好让我永远不必再开口。

lines.en: But all the things that I have learned tell me it's admiration instead, and I pray to the clouds above our heads that I am wrong this time.
lines.zh: 可我学到的一切都告诉我，那是「仰慕」。我向我们头顶的云层祈祷：这次我是错的。

lines.en: The silence is killed off when she evades my oddly comfortable unease like a rabbit dodging predators, and I breathe a sigh of relief in knowing I won't have to face this past this morning.
lines.zh: 她像兔子躲开捕食者一样，避开了我那「奇怪地舒适的别扭」，沉默就此终结。我松了口气——今早之后就不用再面对它了。

lines.en: I just have to face her.
And that's both the easiest and the hardest thing at the same exact time.
lines.zh: 而这恰恰同时是世上最容易、也最难的事。
